observations: Photo 0: front of a black DSLR body with body cap fitted, no lens; badges read 'Canon', 'EOS 5D' and 'Mark II'.
Photo 1: rear of the body, LCD screen off, Canon buttons (MENU, INFO, AF-ON, ON/OFF switch), eyecup fitted; no wear visible at this resolution.
Photo 2: underside plate reads 'Canon DS126201', 'DC 8.1V', 'Made in Japan', serial '3761814763'; battery door is open and no battery is visible.
All three photos are clean studio-style shots on a white background with a dealer watermark 'CDICSON BUSINESS WORLD' and 'Posted on Jiji'; none shows the camera powered on.
No lens, battery, charger or strap is shown.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 front badges read EOS 5D Mark II and photo 2 base plate reads model code DS126201.

claims.claim: Full-frame DSLR with a 21.1 megapixel sensor
claims.evidence: A factory specification of the model, not something the photos can show; it follows from the identity but says nothing about this unit's condition.

risks.risk: Camera may not power on, shutter or sensor may be faulty; no photo shows it running
risks.proof: Clip of the camera switched on, taking a shot and showing the image on the rear screen
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working, body for parts

risks.risk: High shutter count on an older body
risks.proof: Screenshot of the shutter count read from the camera, or a test image's EXIF shown with the serial 3761814763 in the same frame
risks.if_unproven: priced as worn out, end of shutter life

risks.risk: Photos may be stock or catalogue images rather than this unit, given the studio style and dealer watermark
risks.proof: Fresh photo of the camera with a handwritten note bearing today's date and the seller's name beside it, base plate serial visible
risks.if_unproven: priced as body only, not working, until the unit is shown

risks.risk: Battery and charger missing; battery door open and empty in photo 2
risks.proof: Photo of the battery and charger with the camera
risks.if_unproven: priced as body only with no battery or charger

risks.risk: Sensor dust, scratches or mount damage hidden under the body cap
risks.proof: Photo of the open mount and mirror with the body cap removed
risks.if_unproven: priced as needing a sensor clean and mount check

proof_requests: Clip of the camera powering on, taking a photo and reviewing it on the rear screen
Photo with a handwritten dated note next to the camera showing the base serial 3761814763
Photo of the mount and mirror with the body cap off
Photo of included accessories: battery, charger, strap, any lens
response.reason: The badges and base plate identify a Canon EOS 5D Mark II body, so it can be priced as a body only, not working, until a power-on clip and shutter count are shown.
